name: State Transition and Workflow Testing
purpose: Identify distinct workflow paths and state transitions that are directly supported by the provided requirements.

apply_when: The requirement describes multiple system states.
The requirement describes movement from one state to another.
The requirement describes a multi-step workflow.
The requirement describes conditional workflow branches.
The requirement describes different outcomes depending on a previous action.
The requirement describes a before-and-after state.
do_not_apply_when: No workflow or state behavior is described.
A state would have to be invented.
A transition would require an unsupported business rule.
A workflow branch is not supported by the supplied requirements.

coverage_dimensions.name: Initial State
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior from each explicitly defined starting state.

coverage_dimensions.name: Successful Transition
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify each explicitly defined successful state transition.

coverage_dimensions.name: Failed Transition
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined conditions where a state transition must fail or be rejected.

coverage_dimensions.name: Conditional Branch
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify each materially distinct workflow branch described by the requirement.

coverage_dimensions.name: Final State
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify the expected final state after an explicitly defined workflow.

coverage_dimensions.name: Repeated Transition
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify repeated actions only when the requirement defines behavior for repeated actions.

coverage_dimensions.name: Invalid Transition
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify attempts to perform explicitly prohibited or unsupported transitions.

coverage_dimensions.name: State Persistence
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify state remains or changes as explicitly described across the relevant workflow.

coverage_dimensions.name: Recovery Transition
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify recovery from an explicitly defined failure or intermediate state.

examples.requirement: A logged-out user enters valid credentials and is taken to the dashboard.
applicable_scenarios: Successful transition from logged out to logged in

examples.requirement: A submitted request can be approved or rejected by an authorized reviewer.

unknown_information.rule: If a transition outcome or workflow rule is not specified, do not invent it.
